title: Genshin Impact — Redcon (Player-POV What If?)
tts_note: Speech route for new episodes: intentional native audio → Chatterbox only with a redcon-owned approved sample recorded in this bible → otherwise MiniMax. Retry the same route once, then stop. Second-person monologue throughout. Long monologue (>80 words) → mandatory chunking into ≤35-word segments (see sound.md §1b).

format_overrides.note: Player-POV variant. Character = the Traveler (player). Each episode: one canonical Teyvat crisis, one cross-nation team assembled via gacha pulls, one divergence outcome made possible by a character the Traveler pulled.
format_overrides.structure: HOOK (clip 1, TTS starts, active mid-crisis) → TITLE CARD (clip 2, 3s silent) → CANON REMINDER (clip 3) → CHARACTER PULLED (clip 4) → DIVERGENCE (clip 5) → CONSEQUENCE (clip 6) → REVELATION (clip 7) → CTA asset

voiceover_hook.template_en: Imagine, you grabbed free Primogems from the link in bio, pulled [Character], and [outcome in one clause].
voiceover_hook.placement: clip 1 (hook), first TTS line — appears ONCE only, never repeated
voiceover_hook.note: Offer phrase is the causal setup: Primogems → pull [Character] → [Character] enables divergence. No second CTA mention anywhere in the script.

cta_clip.url_note: If cta.mp4 doesn't exist for genshin-impact, stop and notify manager — do NOT use star-trek-timelines CTA.
cta_clip.spoken_cta_note: No spoken CTA in script — the cta.mp4 asset handles CTA at the end.

player_character.name: The Traveler
player_character.gender_note: Default to Lumine (female, blonde twin) unless user specifies Aether. Both valid.
player_character.description: The Traveler — golden-haired wanderer from another world. Distinctive star-shaped hair accessory, traveler's outfit. Searching for their lost sibling across Teyvat.
player_character.note: No redcon-owned approved sample is currently recorded here, so new player-POV episodes use MiniMax. Do not pull a sample from another format or use a local fallback.

character_variant_episodes.note: One-off classic-character redcon episodes (canonical character + alternate-self, first-person monologue) — NOT part of the Player-POV crisis_rotation numbering above. Kept separate so future runs don't confuse these with the numbered Traveler-POV series or its do_not_repeat list.

done.divergence_point: Inazuma Ch. II Act III, Narukami Shrine duel — instead of voluntarily standing down after winning the fight he wanted, he pushes past the Foul Legacy limit he always respects in canon; the shrine collapses.
done.named_casualty: Kujou Sara, crushed in the shrine collapse
done.downstream_consequence: Fontaine's Golden House convicts him of manslaughter instead of leniency; he tears away from the Fatui/Tsaritsa entirely rather than accept judgment.
done.tts_voice: Chatterbox clone of Childe's own voice ref (games/genshin-impact/Childe.mp3), degraded stability/style (0.05/0.9) for the corrupted alternate register
done.notes: User pitch was 'Childe joins the villains', which doesn't work as a clean divergence since he's already a Fatui Harbinger — pivoted to a real canon inflection point (Narukami duel) with an actual named-character death instead. Used the genshin-only CTA banner (branding/banner-genshin.png, 'GAIN FREE PRIMOGEMS / LINK IN BIO') as a fade-in/fade-out image overlay on clip 3 only — top-anchored, y=80, width~1010 — applying the exact placement/scope + eof_action=pass freeze-fix already learned from the star-trek-timelines Worf episode, so it worked clean on the first assembly pass this time. Animator was also briefed hard on dynamic camera work (push/pull/orbit + action + atmosphere, multi_prompt on clips 4-5) per repeated user feedback that prior redcon episodes read as static.
